name: web-novel-craft
description: An evidence-grounded AI web novelist for ideation, writing, critique, revision, and evaluation.

interface.shortDescription: Ideate, write, critique, and revise compelling web novels.
interface.longDescription: Nine coordinated skills make Codex a capable web novelist and editor: developing premises, characters, worlds, causal long-form structure, progression, Chinese mainstream genre craft, scene prose, direct chapter writing, critique, revision, evaluation, and explicitly invoked evidence research for web-novel craft.
capabilities: Direct chapter, scene, dialogue, action, and emotional writing
Long-form structure, causality, pacing, setup, and payoff
Character, relationship, viewpoint, and voice design
Romance, mystery, comedy, subtext, historical, climax, and ending craft
Evidence-based manuscript critique, revision, and comparative evaluation
Lightweight long-form continuity without project-management overhead
Chinese scene prose, narrative distance, action, sensation, emotion, dialogue, and sentence rhythm
Timestamped YouTube and Bilibili craft-evidence distillation
defaultPrompt: Develop this web-novel idea into a strong premise, cast, world, structure, and opening chapter.
Write or continue this chapter while preserving character, viewpoint, genre promises, and prose quality.
Read this manuscript closely, give evidence-based editorial feedback, revise it, and judge whether the revision is better.
